description: Search and filter countries by region, subregion, language, currency, or free-text keyword. At least one filter is required. Returns a ranked list of matching country summaries. Use ref_geo_lookup to get the full record for a specific result.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., "EUR") or currency name (e.g., "Euro").

keyword.description: Matches against country name, native name, capital city, and subregion.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code (e.g., "pt") or language name (e.g., "Portuguese").

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–100).

region.description: Filter by continent region: Africa, Americas, Asia, Europe, Oceania, or Antarctic.

subregion.description: Filter by subregion (e.g., "Western Europe", "Southeast Asia", "South America").

name: ref_geo_search

appliedFilters.description: Active filters applied to the search.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_filters`: No filter or keyword was provided. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Recovery hint when no countries matched — echoes active filters and suggests how to broaden.

results.description: Matching country summaries, up to limit.

capital.description: Capital city, or null if not applicable.

totalMatches.description: Total countries matching the filters before limit is applied.

truncated.description: True when totalMatches exceeds the limit and results are cut off.

title: Country Search
